title: Ohio's 10th Congressional District General Election, 2026
description: This race will determine the U.S. Representative for Ohio's 10th congressional district, which covers all of Montgomery and Greene counties and part of Fayette County, including the city of Dayton. Incumbent Republican Mike Turner, first elected in 2002 and former chair of the House Intelligence Committee, faces Democratic challenger Kristina Knickerbocker, a U.S. Air Force veteran and oncology nurse practitioner. The district was redrawn under Ohio's new congressional map adopted in October 2025. Turner has held the seat for over two decades and is seeking re-election to a 13th term, while Knickerbocker aims to flip the seat for Democrats.

candidates.name: Mike Turner
candidates.summary: Mike Turner has represented Ohio's 10th congressional district (and previously the 3rd district) in the U.S. House since 2003. He previously served as mayor of Dayton from 1994 to 2002 and chaired the House Intelligence Committee from 2023 to 2025. Turner is a member of the moderate Republican Governance Group and has focused on national security, defense, and economic development issues.

candidates.name: Kristina Knickerbocker
candidates.summary: Kristina Knickerbocker is a U.S. Air Force veteran and oncology nurse practitioner running as the Democratic nominee for Ohio's 10th congressional district. She served as a major and nurse in the 88th Air Base Wing at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base and later worked at Ohio State University Medical Center as a Neuro-Oncology Nurse Practitioner. Knickerbocker won the Democratic primary on May 5, 2026, and is challenging incumbent Republican Mike Turner with a focus on healthcare access, economic fairness, and veterans' issues.
